An '''Imperial-controlled house''' on the [[Double Worlds|Twin]] [[Planet/Legends|World]] of [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] was guarded by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was notably guarded by a number of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Stormrifle|riflemen]]. The house was located in a ridge, just southwest of [[Lake Thorn|Lake Bondoma]]. The front porch of the house was decorated with a pot of [[Color/Legends|purple]] [[Plant/Legends|flowers]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] collected these flowers, despite the objections of the stormtroopers.
